title: BITS Pilani Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani (BITS Pilani) has released the official notification for the recruitment of various Junior Research Fellow Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in Any Degree, Post Graduation can grab this chance and apply for the BITS Pilani Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
